'''Esano''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] whose family ran the [[Kozinarg Trade Guilds]]. When members of [[the Scourge]] kidnapped his [[Esano's sister|sister]], he declined to pay the ransom because she had challenged his power. After [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] freed his sister on [[Orto Norwe]], they brought her back to Esano on [[Pleem's Nexus]], her homeworld. She told Esano to give the brothers what they wanted, but he replied that if they killed her, he would be the only heir to their family's fortune. The brothers [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|responded]] by [[Death/Legends|killing]] Esano and his men.<ref name="The Sith Hunters" />
